risks.risk: Cracks or leaks in the inner plastic container

video showing the valve opening and closing

risks.proof: close-up of pallet blocks, cage welds, and base frame

proof_requests: Close-up photos of any embossed labels, capacity markings, or UN codes on the tank
Video of the valve being opened and closed
